notes: Positive: plan a migration, expand/contract, dual-write, backfill, rename safely, NOT NULL safely, ghost column, drop safely, data contract, rollback per phase. Negative: design schema from scratch (data-modeling), execute migration (developer), choose engine (architect), review migration code (code-reviewer). Edge: add nullable column (single-phase), drop table consumer-enumeration intensive, JSON-shape change as semantic.
